back_cover_blurb: Stop fixing AI drafts. Start getting finished work.
You've tried Claude. The answers are impressive, but you still end up rewriting them. This book shows you, step by step and screen by screen, how to get work you can actually use.
- The four-part Finished-Work Formula that turns generic answers into finished ones
- Real screenshots of every feature: files, Projects, memory, Research, connectors, skills and scheduled tasks
- 50 worked workflows with Claude's real answers: email, reading, office work, learning, home and money
- Build calculators, trackers and small apps with no code at all
- Privacy settings and a five-minute routine for checking Claude's work
Updated for Claude in late 2026. No technical background needed.
author_short_bio: Aadhavan Muthurengan writes clear, practical guides to AI for everyday readers and working professionals, including the AI Skillup series.
